scientific_question: Can a single 32-bit learned causal-relation program select and compose *different* nonlinear group operations using public evidence only, while preserving hard-negative discrimination and equal-or-lower complete process CPU/RSS?

observed_previous_BQ_motivation.BO: 48-bit modular learner: 12/12 in representable source, 0/12 Feistel, RSS over comparator
observed_previous_BQ_motivation.BP: 32-bit two-additive-shear learner: 12/12 procedural source, 0/12 unseen nonlinear feedback, 4/12 peak RSS regressions per family

model.name: Learned algebraic-program state with two independently selected reversible operators
model.packed_state: stage1 odd gain 7 bits (1..127), stage1 bias 8 bits, stage2 odd gain 7 bits, stage2 bias 8 bits, stage1 op-mode bit, stage2 op-mode bit = 32 bits total
model.semantics: Each stage transforms one byte using the other: target_new = target OP ((gain*driver+bias) mod 256), with OP learned from public FIT as either mod-256 addition or XOR. Stage1 updates lo driven by hi; stage2 updates hi driven by updated lo. Inversion reverses stage2 then stage1; both group operations are invertible.
model.scientific_difference: Learn both operator modes from 40 FIT alone instead of locking both stages to modular addition as BP did; program composes two source-blind operators with 32 total bits, no family label lookup.
model.learning: Enumerate modes 2 per stage and odd gains 64 per mode; for each gain derive histogram of best bias across 40 public FIT. Select best four stage proposals per stage by actual stage bit errors, then score up to 16 composed full programs against 40 public FIT; CHECK 8 is veto only.
model.computation_bound: 2 stages ×2 modes ×64 gains ×40 samples for bias hist and <=16×40 full pair evaluations (upper 10880 pair checks before per-stage verification). No post-feedback search, source-private key, graph label, or optimizable operator catalog outside the precommitted two primitive operations.
model.training_budgets: 40 FIT,8 CHECK, 6 allowed FIT corrupted single-bit observations, <=2 CHECK bit errors. No source ID, no after-the-fact threshold choice. Strict exact relation graph inverse continuity and disagreement abstention.
model.confidence: Use FIT-ranked model, refuse if FIT>6 errors or CHECK>2 errors. Other near-FIT models within one FIT bit with CHECK<=2 that disagree on any edge inverse force abstention. CHECK cannot select a different best model.
model.native_resource: Measured whole task elapsed CPU and peak OS RSS including public fit, native parser and unchanged 7-active/9-retained transition on identical case vs unmodified F124-AZ true scientific policy. A single per-case CPU or RSS regression blocks science; source-neutral screen is NOT full parity, and AZ abstention must be disclosed.
model.limitation: Two-stage state cannot encode arbitrary deep Feistel or cryptographic relation; success only proves cross-mode transfer within this broader precommitted compositional algebra, never unrestricted nonlinear cognition.

A.grammar: Independent multi-step procedural reversible composition whose net stages use modular ADD then XOR; source private coefficients odd <=127, independent biases; 7..10 graph hops; 40 FIT+8 CHECK with 6 single-bit corruptions; matched hard negative.

B.grammar: Separately born reversible byte-relationship program with XOR then modular ADD and independent multi-step noise-free symbolic logic; no candidate code imports, distinct source seed; matched hard negative.

prospective_sources.generation_guard: No private source cases generated before candidate exact-head Linux+Windows focused qualification, separate provider-original Git tree/blob/source birth and strict OS resource preflight. No protected cohorts constructible.
prospective_sources.two_family_limit: Both families share only predeclared two-stage algebraic-program hypothesis and graph semantics. They are not fully independent or unrestricted nonlinear structures; external novelty not claimed.

acceptance.focus_synthetic: Independent synthetic 6-bit noisy reversible examples; zero causal hard FP, source-blind public mode inference, prospective nonconsuming sample resource, identity-check.
acceptance.protected_firstuse: Only after prequalified source novelty and resource eligibility and successful new development FIT; independently authenticated 128-case cohorts later, source novelty third-party witness separate; original TRAIN recovery not waived.
acceptance.scope: No automatic science promotion from any FIT result; preserve negatives.
